FA No. 50 of 2018 
Hon’ble Lok Pal Singh, J.
Mr. Siddhartha Singh, Advocate 
present for the appellants. 
Heard. 
Admit. 
Issue notice to the respondent fixing 
19.04.2018. 
Steps to be taken within a week. 
Summon the Lower Court Record. 
Also heard on stay application. 
Also heard on stay application. 
It is provided as an interim measure 
that parties shall maintain status quo qua
the nature and possession of the property 
and no third party interest shall be created 
by the parties on the same till the next date 
of listing.
